responsibility: Defines the core target macros, ABI constants, register file description, calling-convention parameters, storage-layout rules, addressing and assembly-format hooks, per-function machine data, and miscellaneous architectural properties for GCC’s TILEPro port. This header is the compile-time specification of the machine model consumed by generic backend code and by tilepro.c, covering register classes and names, stack and return conventions, alignment, PIC/TLS-related register assignments, mode promotion, assembler syntax, and other target configuration fundamentals.
same_name_distinction: Unlike tilepro.c, tilepro.md, and tilepro.opt, this file is the preprocessor-level target specification header: it declares macros, register numbers/classes, calling-convention constants, storage-layout rules, and assembler-format definitions that the rest of the TILEPro port consumes. It describes the machine model and interfaces, rather than implementing hooks, defining RTL instruction patterns, or listing command-line options.
